### LuxExperience Announces First Quarter of Fiscal Year 2027 Earnings Release and Conference Call; Participating in Upcoming Investor Conferences


October 27, 2026


MUNICH--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


LuxExperience B.V. (NYSE:LUXE) (“LuxExperience”), today announced the date for the release of its first quarter of fiscal year 2027 ended September 30, 2026 financial results.


**First Quarter of Fiscal Year 2027 Earnings Call and Webcast**


LuxExperience will release first quarter of fiscal year 2027 financial results before the U.S. market open on November 17, 2026. A conference call to discuss its results will follow at 8:00am Eastern Time that same day.


Event: LuxExperience First Quarter of Fiscal Year 2027 Earnings Conference Call
Event Date: November 17, 2026
Event Time: 8:00am ET
Webcast: Please follow the[link](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fevents.q4inc.com%2Fattendee%2F980607335&esheet=54628848&newsitemid=20261027464761&lan=en-US&anchor=link&index=1&md5=498fa1e57ddac2812a5714d0840765b5)


A webcast replay will be available on LuxExperience’s investor relations website at[investors.luxexperience.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.luxexperience.com%2Foverview%2Fdefault.aspx&esheet=54628848&newsitemid=20261027464761&lan=en-US&anchor=investors.luxexperience.com&index=2&md5=5bdc04935fc47ad3be45290f6a49ddd2) .


**Upcoming Investor Conferences**


LuxExperience will participate at the following investor conferences:


- Jefferies Miami Consumer Conference in Miami, November 17-18, 2026
- J.P. Morgan Global Luxury & Brands Conference in Paris, November 18, 2026
- Morgan Stanley Global Consumer & Retail Conference in New York, December 1-2, 2026


**ABOUT LUXEXPERIENCE**


LuxExperience is the leading digital, multi-brand luxury group and the online shopping destination for luxury enthusiasts worldwide. LuxExperience operates a portfolio of some of the most distinguished store brands in digital luxury and creates communities for luxury enthusiasts with unique digital and physical experiences. Mytheresa, NET-A-PORTER and MR PORTER, jointly comprising the luxury segments of LuxExperience, offer highly curated edits of the most prestigious luxury brands across the world, featuring womenswear, menswear, kidswear, fine jewelry & watches, and lifestyle products. YOOX, which forms the off-price segment of LuxExperience, is the leading destination for multi-brand off-season online luxury shopping. The NYSE listed group operates worldwide.


For more information, please visit[https://investors.luxexperience.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.luxexperience.com&esheet=54628848&newsitemid=20261027464761&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.luxexperience.com&index=3&md5=2bcedbe8b83693a9b933edbf94a304ae) .
